high_level_description: The image shows a close-up of a tree trunk that has been struck by lightning. The lightning strike has exposed the tree's vascular system, which is the network of tubes that transport water and nutrients throughout the tree. The vascular system appears as intricate, swirling patterns of lighter-colored wood against the darker, charred bark around it.
